{{Top|leg}}
'''Mid-Galactic Standard''' was a dialect of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] in use during the lifetime of the [[Holoplay/Legends|holoplaywright]] [[Peshosloc]], over fifteen thousand years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Peshosloc wrote his holoplay ''[[Xim at Vontor]]'' in Mid-Galactic Standard, though the version presented in [[Ronton's Anthology to Galactic Literature, Vol. 2|''Ronton's Anthology to Galactic Literature'', Vol. 2]] had been modernized for contemporary Basic speakers.
